original: あなたが引き受けてくれるのね。\nそれじゃ、説明するよ
traducao: So you'll accept this job.\nLet me explain the details.

original: 目的地はオルタータ火山。\nそこに、つい最近\n星晶採掘が終了した場所があるの
traducao: Your destination is Alterata Volcano.\nA site where Star Crystal mining recently\nwrapped up is located there.

original: そこへ向かって、何か異常がないか\n調査してきてちょうだい
traducao: I want you to head there and investigate\nwhether anything abnormal is occurring.

original: 今回の同行者は、ウィルさんとルビアよ
traducao: Your companions will be Will and Rubia.

original: それじゃあ、お願いね
traducao: Well then, I'm counting on you.

original: あぁ〜〜〜…、暑ぅい…
traducao: Aaargh... it's so hot...

original: 勇んでこの仕事に参加したけど、\nこんなに過酷な所だったなんて…
traducao: I was so eager to take this job,\nnever dreaming it'd be so grueling...

original: それにしても、キールが聞いたという情報が\n気になるな。\n赤い煙か…
traducao: Still, the information Keele heard\npiques my interest.\nRed smoke, was it...?

original: 採掘の際に、\n有害なガスが噴き出したのか…
traducao: Did some toxic gas spew forth\nduring the excavation...?

original: ここは火山だし、\n空気の悪そうな所だし…
traducao: This is a volcano, after all;\nthe air seems pretty foul here...

original: しかし、他の土地でもあったとなると、\n火山性ガスなどの類ではない
traducao: Yet if it occurred in other lands as well,\nit cannot merely be volcanic gas.

original: 生物に変化を及ぼす物質など、\nオレも聞いた事がないしな…
traducao: Even I have never heard of a substance\ncapable of mutating living organisms...

original: 星晶との因果関係もまだ…
traducao: Any link to Star Crystals is still...

original: ああ、もう！\nじっとしていた方が暑苦しいわ
traducao: Aargh, enough!\nStanding still only makes it hotter!

original: 早く先に進みましょ！
traducao: Let's hurry up and move on!

original: 何かしら、今の音…
traducao: What was that sound just now...?

original: ここは近年、安定した状態と\n言われているが、見たところ\nそうでもないらしいな
traducao: This place was said to be stable in recent\nyears, but from the looks of it,\nthat doesn't seem to be the case.

original: ここの火山活動が、\n活発になっているって事？
traducao: You mean the volcanic activity here\nhas grown more violent?

original: 星晶の採掘は、自然にも影響を与えてしまう
traducao: Star Crystal mining also impacts nature.

original: 星晶も、土地に恵みを与える\nマナそのものでもあるからなのね
traducao: Because Star Crystals are mana itself,\nwhich bestows blessings upon the land.

original: この火山でも、採掘は行われた。\nマナの恵みが無くなり、\n不安定な状態になっているのだろう
traducao: Mining occurred at this volcano too.\nRobbed of mana's grace, it likely\nfallen into an unstable state.

original: 星晶がエネルギーとして使用される様に\nなるまで、人々は世界樹が生み出すマナだけで\n生きていたのに…
traducao: Before Star Crystals were used for energy,\npeople lived purely off the mana\nthat the World Tree produces...

original: 昔の人は、マナを生み出してくれる世界樹に\n感謝を捧げていたのに、今の人や文明は\n星晶をむさぼるばかり
traducao: Ancients offered thanks to the World Tree\nthat gave them mana, yet modern folks\nonly greedily devour Star Crystals.

original: 感謝する事すら忘れているわ
traducao: They have forgotten how to give thanks.

original: 星晶を採掘し尽くしてしまうと、\nもう人々は今の様な豊かな暮らしは\n出来なくなるな
traducao: Once Star Crystals are all mined out,\npeople will no longer be able to sustain\nthe affluent life they enjoy today.

original: だが、もっと恐ろしいのは、\n世界樹が生み出している非物質のマナを\nエネルギー利用する技術が出来た時だ
traducao: Yet what is far more terrifying is\nif tech arises to harness non-physical\nmana born from the World Tree.

original: そうなれば、人々はこの世界の生命を支える\nマナまでも奪い尽くすだろう
traducao: Then people would strip away even the mana\nthat supports all life in this world.

original: 一時の繁栄と引き換えに世界樹は枯れ、\n世界は滅亡してしまう
traducao: For fleeting prosperity, the World Tree\nwould wither, and the world perish.

original: 星晶に頼らない世界になればいいな…
traducao: I wish for a world without crystals...

original: 早く、オルタ・ビレッジが\n実現すればいいのに
traducao: I hope Olta Village becomes\na reality as soon as possible...

original: キャッ！　虫！？
traducao: Eek! A bug?!

original: これは…！！\nここにしか生息しない貴重な生物、\n「コクヨウ玉虫」だ
traducao: This is...!!\nA rare species that only lives here:\nthe Obsidian Jewel Beetle.
nota_do_tradutor: Kokuyo / Obsidian Jewel Beetle conforme nota no indice.

original: こんな環境で虫が？\n動かないわ。\n死んでる…？
traducao: A bug in this environment?\nIt isn't moving.\nIs it dead...?

original: コクヨウ玉虫は、この苔を食するのだが。\nこいつも枯れているな…。\n不安定な地熱のせいで枯れたのだろう
traducao: Obsidian Jewel Beetles feed on this moss.\nYet this too has withered... Withered\nfrom volatile geothermal heat, no doubt.

original: やはり、星晶の採掘が原因かもしれんな
traducao: Star Crystal mining may be the cause.

original: コクヨウ玉虫に、この苔…。\nどちらも貴重な種だと言うのに…
traducao: The Obsidian Jewel Beetle, this moss...\nAnd both are such precious species...

original: これって、赤い煙！？
traducao: Is this... that red smoke?!

original: この煙の動きは…！
traducao: The way this smoke is moving...!

original: 何だ、今のは…。\nあの赤い煙、まるで意志がある様に\n動いていた…
traducao: What was that just now...?\nThat red smoke moved as though\nit possessed a will of its own...

original: これは、単なる有害なガスなどでは\n無さそうだ
traducao: This does not appear to be\nany simple toxic gas.

original: む…？\nまだ生きている様だな
traducao: Hm...?\nIt appears to still be alive.

original: ならば、こいつを持って帰るか
traducao: Then let us take this one back with us.

original: ええ〜、気持ちわる〜い
traducao: Eeeew, that is so gross!

original: だが、今の赤い煙が\n生物変化の要因かもしれない。\n調べれば何かわかるだろう
traducao: Yet that red smoke may well be the cause\nof the mutations. Investigating it\nwill surely tell us something.

original: それじゃあ、早く戻りましょう。\nこんな場所、もうこりごりだわ！
traducao: Let's head back right away, then.\nI've had more than enough of this place!

original: 今回、赤い煙が本当に現れたのは、\n収穫だったね
traducao: Having the red smoke actually appear\nwas quite a valuable breakthrough.

original: あの場で生物変化は確認出来なかったが、\n現れたあの赤い煙…
traducao: We couldn't confirm mutations on the spot,\nbut that red smoke which appeared...

original: 奇妙な事に、生きている虫にしか\nまとわり付かなかった
traducao: Strangely, it clung only\nto the living insect.

original: 持ち帰った虫を調べてみたが、\n取り立てて変化は無い
traducao: I examined the insect we brought back,\nbut noticed no particular change.

original: ほんのわずかだが餌も手に入れられた。\nしばらく飼育してみようと思う
traducao: I managed to gather a little food for it,\nso I intend to raise it for a while.

original: はい。\nそれじゃあ、管理はお願いします
traducao: Very well.\nI leave its care in your hands.

original: 優先行動（初級者編）が使えるようになりました！
traducao: Priority Actions (Beginner) are unlocked!

original: よう、少年
traducao: Hey there, laddie.

original: アドリビトムってギルドは、\nここで良かったかな？
traducao: Is this the guild called Ad Libitum?\nDid I come to the right place?

original: おっ、そこのお嬢さん！
traducao: Oho, hey there, young lady!

original: アドリビトムってギルドは、\nここで良かったのかな？
traducao: Is this the guild called Ad Libitum?\nDid I come to the right place?

original: あらー。\nおっさん、そんなに怪しい？\nおっさんの魅力に胸がどきどき？
traducao: Oh my.\nIs old Raven looking suspicious to ya?\nHeart pounding at this old guy's charm?

original: あら、この人があなたの魅力を\nわかってくれる人だったらいいのだけれど
traducao: My, if only this person were capable\nof appreciating your charms.

original: …ジュディスちゃん…
traducao: ...Judith...

original: 私達、ここで働きたいの。\nリーダーはどちら？
traducao: We'd like to work here.\nWho might the leader be?

original: はい、わたしがこのギルド\nアドリビトムのリーダー、アンジュです。\n何か御用でしょうか？
traducao: Yes, I am Ange, leader of this guild,\nAd Libitum.\nHow may I help you?

original: 私はジュディス。\nそして彼が…
traducao: I am Judith.\nAnd this is...

original: 俺はレイヴン。\nここにユーリのあんちゃんいるっしょ？
traducao: I'm Raven.\nYuri's staying here, ain't he?

original: 俺達、あいつが元いたギルドの仲間なのよ
traducao: We're buddies from his former guild, see.

original: エステルの依頼を受けたあとで、\n彼、指名手配になったでしょう？
traducao: After taking Estelle's request,\nhe ended up a wanted man, you see.

original: そーそー、そのせいで俺達のギルドまで\nガサ入れが入っちゃって、エステル嬢ちゃん\n誘拐の手引きをしたと疑いをかけられてるのよ
traducao: Right on! Our guild got raided over it,\nand they suspect us of helping him kidnap\nlittle Lady Estelle!

original: ま、手引きをしたのはウソじゃないんだけどね
traducao: Well, can't say we didn't help him out.

original: そんで、ガルバンゾをしばらく出た方が\nいいんじゃないかねって
traducao: So we figured we'd best clear out\nof Garbanzo for a while.

original: ユーリがここで仕事をしてるって\n噂を聞いたから来てみたの
traducao: We heard rumors Yuri was working here,\nso we decided to visit.

original: どうかしら？\nここで働かせてもらえない？
traducao: What do you say?\nWould you let us work here?

original: オッケーよ。\nそれじゃあ、加入の手続きをするね
traducao: Sounds good to me.\nI'll process your registration right away.

original: ふい〜。\nやっと、逃亡生活とおさらばなのね
traducao: Phew!\nFinally bidding life on the run goodbye!

original: んじゃ、これからよろしくな、少年！
traducao: Well then, countin' on ya, laddie!

original: んじゃ、これからよろしくな、お嬢さん！
traducao: Well then, countin' on ya, young lady!

original: ジュディスがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Judith has joined Ad Libitum.

original: レイヴンがアドリビトムに加入しました
traducao: Raven has joined Ad Libitum.

original: すみません…。\nアドリビトムというギルドは\nこちらでしょうか？
traducao: Excuse me...\nIs this the guild known\nas Ad Libitum?

original: はい
traducao: Yes!

original: 私は、モラード村から来ました。\nジョアンと言います。\nここへ、依頼をしに来たんですけど…
traducao: I came from Morado Village.\nMy name is Joan.\nI came to post a request, but...
nota_do_tradutor: Morado Village e Joan conforme INDICE_NOMES.

original: どういった依頼でしょうか？
traducao: What kind of request might it be?

original: ゴホッ…！！\nブラウニー坑道の奥地へ行きたくて、\n護衛を…ゴホゴホッ…、お願いしたいんです
traducao: *cough*...!!\nI wish to go deep into Brownie Mine,\nand need an escort... *cough, hack*...

original: 顔色が随分悪い様ですが、\nお薬をもってきましょうか？
traducao: You look terribly pale;\nshall I bring you some medicine?

original: いいえ、私の病気は薬では治りません。\n医者ですら、さじを投げたんですから…
traducao: No, medicine cannot cure my disease.\nEven doctors threw their hands up...

original: でも、治す方法が一つだけ…
traducao: Yet there is only one way to cure it...

original: そのブラウニー坑道の奥には\n「病気を治してくれる存在」が\nいるそうなので…
traducao: Deep within Brownie Mine,\nthey say there lives a being who can\ncure illnesses...

original: 病気を治す…？
traducao: Cure illnesses...?

original: 護衛を…、ゴホッ…、\n引き受けていただけますか…？
traducao: Would you... *cough*...\naccept this escort mission...?

original: はい…。\n依頼とあれば…
traducao: Yes...\nIf it is a request...

original: では、受けていただける時に\n連絡を下さい
traducao: Then please contact me\nwhen you are ready to accept.

original: 失礼します…、ゴホゴホゴホッ…！
traducao: Excuse me... *cough, hack, cough*...!

original: はい。\nでは、お体、お大事になさって下さいね
traducao: Yes.\nPlease take good care of yourself, okay?
